# Northwind leave policy

Version 2. This policy applies to all permanent employees of Northwind.

## Annual leave

Permanent employees receive 27 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
Leave is requested in the staff portal at least two weeks before the first day off.

## Sick leave

Employees who are ill notify their manager before 10:00 on the first day of absence.
A medical certificate is required from day 2 of an absence onwards.

## Parental leave

Each parent may take 16 weeks of paid parental leave within the first year after a birth or adoption.
